findings.text: When the source and target values have different Go types, mergeMaps logs an error and `continue`s, so the merged-in value is silently dropped and the old value stays. Example: the base config has `port: 80` (int) and the merged file has `port: "8080"` (string) or `port: null`. MergeConfig returns nil, but the override never takes effect.
